title: Saturday morning
instructions: Lucy cumartesi sabahını anlatıyor. Saatlere ve sıraya dikkat et.

script.speaker: lucy
script.text: On Saturday, I don't go to school.

script.speaker: lucy
script.text: I get up late, at nine o'clock.

script.speaker: lucy
script.text: I have pancakes for breakfast with my family.

script.speaker: lucy
